decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood product it is less central to the firm's growing industrial waste-to-value and energy technology focus, so management would likely reallocate effort to higher-fit technology projects.
These modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the firm's engineering-led core offer, match demand for decentralized sustainable systems, and can be developed as a scalable product line.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a flagship product squarely in line with the firm's stated direction and technical capabilities, so it would likely remain on the market.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is strategically important and close to the firm's core sustainability proposition, even if commercialization risk is somewhat higher than for its more established energy solutions.
